earnings.title: Investor Relations
highlights: $224.9 million net income and $238.8 million adjusted net income for the quarter, increases of 6.8% and 15.6%, respectively, from prior year period
$0.94 diluted earnings per share (“Diluted EPS”) and $1.02 adjusted diluted earnings per share for the quarter
$584.5 million quarterly revenues, an increase of 14.9% ( 15.4% on a constant currency basis) compared to prior year period
$258.5 million quarterly international revenues, an increase of 22.4% ( 23.8% on a constant current basis) compared to prior year period
$0.14 per share quarterly cash dividend declared, a 16.7% per share increase from prior year period
